long-haired-hare.synopsis: After opera singer Giovanni Jones takes serious offense at Bugs Bunny's banjo playing inadvertently disrupting his rehearsals, Bugs retaliates during the maestro's performance.

dog-gone-south.synopsis: Down south, Charlie Dog tries to get Colonel Shuffle to adopt him, even if it means sabotaging his relationship with his current dog, Belvedere the bulldog, to do it.
